analyticalQuestion: On the complete slow interval, do the finite selected orbits retain bounded action-normalized gain, develop asymptotically linear-in-epsilon complementary leakage, satisfy the forward-orbit backward-action bound, and pass cutoff and independent-integrator checks?
supportedTakeaway: Across five epsilon values and three cutoffs, the finite selected gain remains within 0.0007 of its instantaneous viscous action, the three smallest epsilon values give leakage slope 1.028, the backward-action residual remains below 0.000672, and all cutoff and independent-integrator discrepancies are far below their frozen tolerances.

dataSufficiency.fallback: Fail closed if any configured case, slow-time node, cutoff comparison, or independent reconstruction is absent.
